name: Extreme heat
value: Severe heatwave, Cape York Peninsula (18 Nov)
summary: BoM severe heatwave warning for Queensland's Peninsula renewed on 18 Nov; no deadly top-tier event found
state: The Bureau of Meteorology's warning issued at 1:29pm on 18 Nov keeps severe heatwave conditions over the Peninsula district, with maximums in the high 30s to near 40°C, easing towards the end of the week (WillyWeather, citing BoM). Weipa had 41 straight days above 36°C to 15 Nov, its longest run on record (The Watchers). A regional severe warning meets the Watch line; searches on 18 Nov found no deadly heatwave under top-tier warnings across a large population.
for_you: Mainly affects residents of far north Queensland. Travellers to the area can follow Bureau of Meteorology heatwave warnings and Queensland Health heat advice. No UK heat risk at this time of year.
rubric_hit: Watch: regional heatwave warning (BoM severe, Peninsula district, 18 Nov); no deadly top-tier event for Alert

sources.title: WillyWeather — BoM heatwave warning, Peninsula district

why: Heat is the deadliest weather hazard globally, straining power grids, crops and health systems.
drivers: Heat domes, climate warming, season, humidity, urban heat islands.

rubric.alert: Deadly heatwave with top-tier official warnings across a large population.
rubric.watch: Heatwave warnings across a major region, or national temperature records.
rubric.normal: No major heatwaves affecting large populations.
